questions.stem: What is observed when ethanol reacts with sodium metal?

options.text: The sodium floats and fizzes gently, producing hydrogen gas
The solution turns orange to green

questions.explanation: Ethanol reacts gently with sodium metal: 2C2H5OH + 2Na -> 2C2H5O-Na+ + H2. The sodium fizzes gently as hydrogen gas is produced. This reaction is much slower than sodium with water because the hydrocarbon chain in ethanol reduces reactivity.
